signal_paths.metrics: Registered app/exporter → central Prometheus private scrape → Grafana/Observability API; Prometheus rules → Alertmanager
signal_paths.logs: stdout/journal → Alloy → Loki → Grafana/Observability API; OTLP-only log sources use OTel → Loki /otlp/v1/logs instead
signal_paths.traces: SDK → local Alloy OTLP receiver → central OpenTelemetry gateway → Tempo → Grafana/Observability API
signal_paths.alerts: Prometheus → Alertmanager → existing Middleware events API → durable incident/outbox → existing command executor/Temporal → Klyrow adapter → provider read-back
signal_paths.configuration: Component Git authorities + service descriptors → tested immutable release → approved reconciler → observed revision/read-back
signal_paths.analytics: Odoo/Middleware/provider event projections → curated read-only views → Superset

schema_note: Engineering inventory. Machine-readable executable HTTP schema is Middleware contracts/observability/integrated-monitoring.openapi.json.
implementation_limits: Profile writes stage a durable revision. The reconciler compares approved and observed digests and never deploys configuration.
GitHub ingestion records signed repository events; it does not update the approved catalog or authorize releases.
Backend queries use reviewed named templates and release-mounted identities. No live backend connection was certified.
Runtime agents must be bound to service and deployment identities. Repository inventory alone does not prove telemetry coverage.
BFF, scrape/reconciliation scheduling, durable event retention, gateway quotas, app instrumentation and release activation are separate rollout work.
